newsitem.title: UK: OSCE to meet in emergency session on Saturday - UK.
newsitem.headline: OSCE to meet in emergency session on Saturday - UK.

text.p: The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) will meet in emergency session in Vienna on Saturday to discuss the crisis in Albania, British officials said on Friday.
They said the meeting was due to start at 1000 a.m. (0900 GMT).

OSCE negotiator Franz Vranitzky, a former Austrian Chancellor, is currently holding talks with Albanian government ministers to try to resolve the unrest that began in January over the collapse of shady pyramid savings schemes.
The problems have since erupted into a nationwide insurrection by rebels calling for President Sali Berisha to quit.
Rebel leaders were expected to join the talks with Vranitzky, being held aboard an Italian warship in the Adriatic, later on Friday.

Western governments have pinned their hopes on the 54-member state OSCE brokering a deal with the Albanian government and rebel leaders to end the armed rebellion and the anarchy spreading throughout the country.
